message.content:
In this Next.js frontend at d:\_ntu台大\futureclass_未來教室\_dev\FutureClassroom\frontend, there's a bug: on the home/dashboard page there's a "近期查看" (recently viewed) section listing recently viewed lessons. Clicking an item navigates to a URL like `/course/undefined/lesson/1142_247%2010050__14_0527` — the `courseKey` segment is literally the string "undefined" instead of the real course key. Also, on the lesson detail page itself, the "回上一頁" (back) button/link is built from the same missing courseKey, so it's also broken (goes to `/course/undefined`).

I need you to research and report back (READ ONLY, do not write code):

1. Find `frontend/app/home/page.tsx` (or wherever the home dashboard lives) and show me the "近期查看" section — where does its data come from (API call, localStorage, cookies)? What fields does each item have, and specifically: does it include a `course_key` field? Show the exact link-building code (likely a `<Link href={...}>` or `router.push(...)`) that constructs the `/course/{courseKey}/lesson/{lessonId}` URL, with line numbers.

2. Compare against the "最新分析" section on the same page (which we know comes from `GET /lessons/latest`, per prior research — that endpoint's `LatestLessonDto` does include `CourseKey`). Does "近期查看" use the same data source/endpoint or a different one? If different, where does it come from — is it a separate "recently viewed" tracking mechanism (e.g. writing to localStorage when a lesson is opened)?

3. Find the lesson detail page (`frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx`) and show me exactly how the "回上一頁" back link/button is built — what variable does it use for the courseKey in the href, and where does that variable come from (route param, fetched data, etc)? Explain why it could end up as the literal string "undefined".

4. If "近期查看" is backed by a client-side recently-viewed tracker (e.g. localStorage), find where lessons get recorded into that tracker (likely in the lesson detail page's useEffect) — check whether `courseKey` is actually being captured/stored there, or if it's omitted/mistyped (e.g. reading `params.courseKey` when the param key is actually named differently, or storing only `lessonId` without `courseKey`).

Report back concisely (under 400 words) with file paths, line numbers, and short code snippets pinpointing exactly where `courseKey` is lost or never captured.

content.text: I'll research this codebase to trace the courseKey bug.

I now have the core answer. The lesson detail page's back link actually correctly uses `params.courseKey` from the URL route (line 292-297), so it works correctly *if* the URL that navigated there had a real courseKey. So the bug is entirely upstream — the "近期查看" section itself constructs a bad URL. Let me check the DataCard component to see the actual link-building code.

Now I have the complete picture. Both "近期查看" and "最新分析" share the same `DataCard` component and the same link-building code at line 107. Let me also check for any localStorage-based "recently viewed" tracker to fully answer question 4.

No localStorage-based tracker exists anywhere in the frontend — confirming "近期查看" is not backed by any client-side recently-viewed mechanism at all.

## Report

**1. "近期查看" data source** — `frontend/app/home/page.tsx` lines 13-58: it's **entirely hardcoded mock data**, `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES`, marked `// TODO: 從 API 獲取最近查看過的課程`. Each item has fields `id, name, date, course_id, class, schedule, lesson_id, last_checked_at, generated_at` — **there is no `course_key` field at all**. It's rendered via `<DataCard title="近期查看" data={RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES} .../>` (line 242-248).

**2. Comparison with "最新分析"** — "最新分析" fetches real data from `GET /api/lessons/latest` (lines 140-176) and explicitly maps `course_key: lesson.course_key` into `LatestLessonCardItem` (line 159), matching the `LatestLessonDto.CourseKey` backend field. "近期查看" uses a **completely different, static, hardcoded array** with no backing API call and no `course_key` property. It is not currently backed by any localStorage/cookie-based recently-viewed tracker — a repo-wide search for `localStorage`/"recently viewed" found no such mechanism anywhere in `frontend/`.

**3. Link-building code (shared by both sections)** — `frontend/components/DataCard.tsx` line 107:
```tsx
<Link href={`/course/${item.course_key}/lesson/${item.lesson_id}`} key={idx}>
```
Since `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES` items have no `course_key` property, `item.course_key` is `undefined`, and template-literal interpolation stringifies it to the literal text `"undefined"` — producing `/course/undefined/lesson/1142_247%2010050__14_0527`.

**4. Lesson detail page back link** — `frontend/app/course/[courseKey]/lesson/[lessonId]/page.tsx`, `PageHeader` component, lines 290-318. It correctly derives `courseKey` from `useParams()` (the route segment itself, lines 292-297), and builds:
```tsx
<Link href={courseKey ? `/course/${courseKey}` : "/course"}>
```
This logic is *correct* — the "回上一頁" link is only broken because it inherits the bad `courseKey="undefined"` route param from the incoming URL (produced by bug #1). There's no separate capture/storage bug here; nothing writes to a recently-viewed tracker in this file either (no such `useEffect` exists in the codebase).

**Root cause**: `RECENTLY_VIEWED_COURSES` in `frontend/app/home/page.tsx` (lines 13-58) is mock/placeholder data missing `course_key`, and there is no real "recently viewed" API or client-side tracking mechanism implemented yet — the TODO comment on line 12 confirms this was never wired up.
